name: Acme Demo Foundation — Procurement & Travel Policy [SAMPLE]

rules.description: Three independent written quotes required for any purchase $1,000 USD or above. Quotes must be from legally distinct suppliers, dated within 30 days, and signed.
rules.evidence_required: At least 3 quote documents from different suppliers.

rules.description: Every vendor must have a valid business registration certificate on file before payment.
rules.evidence_required: Vendor registration certificate (CAC, Companies House, or equivalent).

rules.description: Every invoice must include: supplier legal name, registered address, tax registration, itemised line items, total, date, unique invoice number, bank details.
Physical-goods deliveries require a signed Goods Received Note within 5 working days of delivery.
Sign-off must match value: <$1k line manager; $1k-$5k +Finance Officer; $5k-$25k +Finance Director; $25k+ +ED.
rules.evidence_required: Approval signatures on requisition matching the value band.

rules.description: Sole-source purchases above $1,000 require written ED approval AND a sole-source justification memo.
No single cash payment may exceed $500 USD equivalent. Larger payments must be by bank transfer.
rules.evidence_required: Bank transfer proof for any payment over $500.

rules.description: Payment vouchers must include original receipts, not photocopies. Affidavit accepted if original genuinely unavailable.
Travel advances must be retired with original receipts within 14 days of return.
rules.evidence_required: Retirement document with attached original receipts.

rules.description: Per diems may not exceed published rate-card values without ED approval.
rules.evidence_required: Per diem amount matched against rate card.
